leads.title: Bahamas Marriage Act
leads.documents: Non-recognition of same-sex marriage/partnerships; defines Bahamian marriage as composed of a man and woman.
leads.detail: No URL in text; cited as 'Bahamas Marriage Act states that a Bahamian marriage is composed of a man and woman'

leads.title: Maritime Marriage Bill / Maritime Marriage Law (July 2011) - Statement by Zhivargo Laing
leads.documents: Government affirmation that marriage must be between male and female and void if male-male or female-female; community standard on same-sex unions.
leads.detail: No URL in text; cited as July 2011 ratification, quote from former Minister of State for Finance Zhivargo Laing

leads.title: Data Protection (Privacy of Personal Information) Act, Section 1 (2003)
leads.documents: Limited protection including 'sexual life' among protected sensitive personal data since 2003.
leads.detail: No URL in text; cited as 'Since 2003, Section 1... includes sexual life among the protected sensitive personal data'

leads.title: Communications Act (2009) - Content Regulation / URCA codes of practice
leads.documents: Anti-vilification machinery; URCA may regulate content and issue codes considering material inciting hatred against group on basis of sexual preference, gender, etc.
leads.detail: No URL in text; cited as 'The Communications Act (2009) on Content Regulation' and Utilities Regulation and Competition Authority (URCA)

leads.title: Constitution of The Bahamas and Constitutional Reform Commission Preliminary Report 21 March 2006
leads.documents: Constitutional non-discrimination clause does not include sexual orientation or gender identity; 2006 Commission recommended equal treatment regardless of religion, political affiliation, race, sex and gender but did not regard sexual orientation as deserving protection.
leads.detail: No URL in text; cited as 21 March 2006 preliminary report to Progressive Liberal Party (PLP) government

leads.title: Employment Bill (2001)
leads.documents: Failed workplace protection; proposed clause banning workplace discrimination based on sexual orientation was removed after passage.
leads.detail: No URL in text; cited as 2001 government proposed Employment Bill

leads.title: UN Declaration on Sexual Orientation and Gender Identity - Bahamas endorsement 17 June 2011
leads.documents: Foreign-policy stance on LGBT rights; Bahamas expressed support but took no domestic non-discrimination statutory action.
leads.detail: No URL in text; cited as 'On 17 June 2011, the Bahamian Government expressed support for the UN declaration'

leads.title: Government of Canada travel advice for The Bahamas (December 2018)
leads.documents: Official foreign-government risk assessment warning gay couples about risk of homophobia in The Bahamas; relevant to visitor safety.

leads.title: Bahamas Plays and Films Control Board censorship decisions - Brokeback Mountain (March 2006) and Children of God (24 June 2011)
leads.documents: State enforcement of anti-LGBT content restrictions; ban of gay-themed film and attempted block of Bahamian gay-themed film in public square, overruled by government in 2011 case.
leads.detail: No URL in text; cited with dates March 2006 and 24 June 2011, downtown Nassau public square showing

leads.title: Bahamas homicide rulings invoking gay panic defence - 2009 acquittal and 10 June 2010 sentencing; Court of Appeal President Joan Sawyer
leads.documents: Enforcement/impunity pattern; jury acquittal in murder of homosexual HIV-positive man and lenient sentence in shooting death of gay man after homosexual advance claim; judicial statement that one is entitled to use whatever force necessary to prevent being victim of homosexual act.
